snippet.title: The Division 2: Spearfall - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Agents, it's time to unite.
 
Squad up with friends across platforms now that Crossplay is available in The Division 2. Whether you're a veteran Agent returning to the fight or a new recruit answering the call, there's never been a better time to join your squad and defend Washington, D.C.
 
Face White Tusk as they launch a new assault across the capital. Take on new Legendary content, encounter White Tusk throughout the open world for the first time, and push back against their growing presence across the city.
 
Customize your Prototype Gear, tackle a redesigned Escalation experience, and earn rewards through the Season Pass and Veteran Rewards.
 
The Division 2: Spearfall launches on November 26.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC. In the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York. In Battle for Brooklyn, defend the borough as the Cleaners cross the river. And in Echoes of Central Park, answer a distress signal from deep within the park and face a new threat.

#Ubisoft #TheDivision2
Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
